verdict.rationale: The only documented install path is a one-line shell script (curl | sh). That is a quick installer but not a standard package manager such as Homebrew, apt, winget, or pip for the runtime. The Python and JavaScript libraries are client libraries, not the runtime, so they do not transfer to this story. No evidence shows Ollama being distributed through a standard package manager.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
